name: heat_object_then_place_on_surface
description: When a task requires placing a hot object on a target surface, first pick up the object, then heat it in a microwave, then move it to the specified surface. Applicable when the object is initially cold and a microwave is available.

evidence.feedback: You arrive at coffeemachine 1. On the coffeemachine 1, you see a mug 1.
You pick up the mug 1 from the coffeemachine 1.
You arrive at microwave 1. The microwave 1 is closed.
You open the microwave 1. The microwave 1 is open. In it, you see a apple 2, and a egg 1.
You heat the mug 1 using the microwave 1.
You arrive at sidetable 1. On the sidetable 1, you see a knife 1, a soapbottle 1, a spoon 1, and a tomato 2.
You move the mug 1 to the sidetable 1.
